issue.title: feat(workflows): add coming soon interest for receiving email

labels.name: repo-b94bc5f2
labels.description: Request AI approval (no full review)

issue.body:
## Problem

- The Workflows team is gauging interest in receiving email in PostHog, and can't see who wants it.

## Changes

- The Transactional email log now shows Receiving, with a "Coming soon" tag, beside Sending. Sending stays selected, and no receiving feature sits behind it.
- A click records interest right away and opens a box asking what they'd use it for and what they use today.
- A note joins the same response, and closing the box keeps the interest.
- Another click reopens the note and sends the interest again under the same response, so a click lost offline gets counted later. After a note is sent, clicks send nothing.
- Answers and drafts are stored per account, so the next person on the same browser never sees them.
- The SMTP "Coming soon" interest, already on master, now uses the same per-account storage and resend. Answers someone already saved there are kept, but only for the account that saved them.
- The tag reads "Interest noted", also after a reload.
- Mechanical: the feedback banner's event code moves to a shared file. Its events stay the same.

[Survey](https://us.posthog.com/project/2/surveys/01a1b1bc-f392-0000-cf5e-2ea91af5cb0b): `api` type, so it never shows a pop-up.

## How did you test this code?

Clicked through in a browser on an isolated local stack, reading each `survey sent` from the `/e/` request body.

- Not run: delivery to the real survey, because local `/e/` answers 403. Its question ids were compared through the API.
- Simulated: ClickHouse rows for the list query, written directly with these properties.
- Not run: the `today-rail-nav` layout, and the scene with its flag off.

<details>
<summary>Edge cases</summary>

| Case | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Hover | Tooltip explains the feature and the click |
| Click | One `survey sent`, `$survey_completed` false, box opens, URL and log unchanged |
| Not now, Esc | Box closes, interest stays, no event |
| Second click | Same submission id sent again, box reopens with the note |
| Reload, with and without a draft | Still "Interest noted", no event, draft kept |
| Note with Japanese, emoji, HTML, quotes, outer spaces | Sent as text, trimmed, same submission id, interest repeated on the event |
| Blank note | Send stays disabled |
| 6,000 characters pasted | Cut to 5,000, sent |
| Double click | One event, box stays open |
| Second tab open before the first click | Same submission id, so one response |
| `/e/` aborted by the network | UI unchanged, posthog-js retried, both events sent with the same id after recovery |
| Keyboard only | Tab then Space opens, focus in the box, Ctrl+Enter sends |
| Window 900 and 700, scene 520 and 380 | Toggle fits above the filters, nothing overflows |

</details>

**Test rationale:** `comingSoonInterestLogic.test.ts` catches duplicate responses, a note split from its interest, a click after a note replacing it, one account seeing another's draft, SMTP answers saved before this change being lost or shown to another account, and a double click closing the box. No existing test covers this logic.

**CI report:** the complexity warning names a function this PR adds no branches to. The bundle growth is all in files from the master merge (elkjs, react-json-view, other products), none from the Transactional scene. The 4% comment density covers pinned values, reasons the code cannot show, and 3 generated kea type markers.

Also tested in a browser on a local stack, before the latest push: a second account on the same browser sees "Coming soon" and an empty note after the first account left a draft.

Not rerun in a browser after the latest push (per-account storage and resend on click). Covered by the logic tests only.

## Release status

- This change is behind a feature flag and is not available to users <!-- release-status: behind-feature-flag -->

## Docs update

- None.

## 🤖 Agent context

**Autonomy:** Human-driven (agent-assisted)

**Agent:** Claude Code, Claude Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`)

**Skills:** `/writing-ui-components`, `/writing-tests`, `/writing-pr-descriptions`, and the skills listed below

<details>
<summary>More context for AI agents</summary>

- **Session:** T3 Code, Playwright MCP, PostHog MCP
- **Decisions:** Uses the scene's existing `workflows-transactional-email-api` flag, no new flag.
- **Decisions:** The submission id is the user's uuid, so tabs and browsers share one response.
- **Decisions:** Also sends `survey shown` once per log view until interest is recorded, matching the banner, to give a click rate.
- **Decisions:** The shared files match the SMTP PR byte for byte, so either PR can land first.
- **Skills:** posthog-local-e2e-qa, writing-kea-logics, writing-user-facing-copy, writing-code-comments, verifying-changes, writing-plainly, creating-surveys, querying-posthog-data
- **Read closely:** `comingSoonInterestLogic.ts`

</details>

issue.body:
## Problem

- Received email ([#130637](https://github.com/PostHog/posthog/pull/130637)) has no way out: code and agents can't list it, read it, or set up an address.

## Changes

- `received_emails` lists mail without bodies, with search and dates.
- One email returns its text, verdicts, person and original send.
- Download links appear only after a passed virus scan.
- `inbound_email_domains` gives a ready-made address, adds a domain, and checks its MX record.
- A domain must be a verified sending domain, or a subdomain of one.
- MCP tools `received-emails-list` and `received-emails-get` wrap results as untrusted data, and leave out headers and links.
- Everything sits behind `workflows-inbound-email`.
- Mechanical: generated types and MCP schemas.

## How did you test this code?

<details><summary>Steps</summary>

- Called both tools over the MCP protocol on a local MCP server against the real API, with the tool flag overridden. Both replies came inside `<received-email-data>`. The get reply had no `headers`, `raw` or `download_url`.
- Read the detail API for `PASS`, `GRAY` and `PROCESSING_FAILED` mail in the browser ([#130639](https://github.com/PostHog/posthog/pull/130639)). Only `PASS` returned links.

</details>

**Test rationale:** API cases catch a link after a failed scan and activation with no sending domain.

## Release status

- This change is behind a feature flag and is not available to users <!-- release-status: behind-feature-flag -->

issue.body:
## Problem

- Workflows has nowhere to record which project owns a receiving domain, or what mail it received. Inbound email needs both ([#130637](https://github.com/PostHog/posthog/pull/130637)).

## Changes

- New tables: `InboundEmailDomain` and `ReceivedEmail`, with no callers yet.
- Only one project can hold a domain once it's active.
- A message lands once per project, because `team` and the SES message ID are unique together.
- Bodies stay in object storage, so these tables hold only what a search needs.
- `checks_failing_since` lets an active domain ride out a brief DNS or SES problem.
- Mechanical: new enums and IDOR rule entries.

## How did you test this code?

- `makemigrations --check` reports no drift after the migration edit.
- [#130637](https://github.com/PostHog/posthog/pull/130637) wrote and read these rows for real.

**Test rationale:** No test here. [#130637](https://github.com/PostHog/posthog/pull/130637) exercises the constraints.

issue.body:
## Problem

- People reading a transactional email's log page see "Back in your app" when the person never left the app.
- Sensitive emails show "Clicked: Not yet", although their clicks can never be recorded.

## Changes

- After only an open, the sentence now needs a new session, or a page view after 30 quiet minutes.
- After a click, any activity in the app still counts.
- Sensitive emails now show "Not tracked" on Clicked, with an info icon that explains why.

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Never left | ![Before: back in your app shown](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5294d040-cedc-46b9-aa3f-e1446705fd3d) | ![After: plain gap row](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1bca79a5-02ae-4b4c-b5b8-bb8fb718aa78) |
| Sensitive | ![Before: clicked not yet](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/75081c4b-1dc3-4207-88fe-34123210c6c8) | ![After: clicked not tracked](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/85c2cdd1-1116-45bd-91b3-af1a5a634f83) |

## How did you test this code?

Playwright drove the page on a local stack, with invented ClickHouse rows. Both bugs reproduced with the fix reverted.

Not tested: real sends, and sensitive rows in the log list.

**Test rationale:** Extended `emailActivity.test.ts` and `emailDeliverySteps.test.ts` for both regressions.

<details>
<summary>Browser cases and ClickHouse read back</summary>

| Case | "Back in your app" or Clicked step |
|---|---|
| Same session across send and open | No sentence |
| Session started after send, before open | No sentence |
| New session after open | 4m after opening |
| Same session, then a new session | 9m after opening |
| Sessionless page view, 11m after other activity | No sentence |
| Sessionless page view, over 2h after other activity | 2m after opening |
| Click, then same session | 1m after clicking |
| Server-side event only | No sentence |
| No activity | No sentence, empty state shown |
| Sensitive, opened, not opened, or queued | Not tracked |
| Sensitive with a click event | Done, with the click time |
| Non-sensitive, not clicked | Not yet |
| Sensitive failed, bounced, or marked as spam | No Clicked step |

Tooltip: opens on hover, on keyboard focus (Tab reaches it), and on click. Escape closes it. At 540px the steps stack and nothing overflows. No new console errors.

After those browser checks, the tooltip gained a sentence saying older sends can still record clicks, and two step parts moved into small functions. Jest and the typecheck ran on that push. The browser steps were not repeated.

The page only knows if the template is sensitive now, not when the email went out. An older send of a template marked sensitive later, or from before links stopped being tracked, still shows "Not tracked", so the tooltip says so.

```sql
SELECT distinct_id, event, timestamp, JSONExtractString(properties,'$session_id')!='' AS has_session, JSONExtractString(properties,'$pathname')
FROM sharded_events WHERE team_id=7 AND distinct_id LIKE 'qa_return_%' ORDER BY distinct_id,timestamp
```

```text
qa_return_same-session  $pageview  2026-11-05 09:55:00  1  /files
qa_return_same-session  $pageview  2026-11-05 10:02:00  1  /files
qa_return_same-session  $pageview  2026-11-05 10:03:00  1  /files
qa_return_new-session   $pageview  2026-11-05 08:02:00  1  /files
qa_return_new-session   $pageview  2026-11-05 10:07:00  1  /pricing
```

All fixtures were deleted afterwards, and each table returned a count of 0.

</details>

## Release status

- No feature flag controls this change <!-- release-status: no-feature-flag -->

## Docs update

- None.

The CI report's 1 KiB bundle size warning is the new note and icon, on a page that loads on its own. Its complexity warnings are for functions already over the limit, which this PR makes simpler or leaves unchanged.

## 🤖 Agent context

**Autonomy:** Human-driven (agent-assisted)

**Agent:** Claude Code, Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`)

**Skills:** `/writing-ui-components`, `/writing-user-facing-copy`, `/writing-tests`, `/writing-code-comments`, `/verifying-changes`, `posthog-local-e2e-qa`, `/writing-pr-descriptions`, `/writing-plainly`

<details>
<summary>More context for AI agents</summary>

- Decisions: the requester chose the open-only return rule and the sensitive copy.
- Click then open then activity now reads "after clicking", because a click counts first.
- The "By email" metrics table still shows a clicked share for sensitive emails. Left unchanged, because it is another page.
- Duplicate search: no open PR fixes this.
- Public artifact: all test data is invented, with reserved domains only.

</details>
